{{Top|leg}}
The '''Skann spacers' bar''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|drinking establishment]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skann]]. At the bar, [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] frequently could obtain only quick-brewed [[Rotgut/Legends|rotgut]] instead of higher-quality [[Skannbult Likker]].<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>
